definitions.explanation: A ceremony held in January for those who turned 20 during the past year.

examples.japanese: {成人式|せいじんしき}に{振袖|ふりそで}を{着|き}る。
examples.english: To wear furisode for the coming-of-age ceremony.

examples.japanese: {成人式|せいじんしき}で{同級生|どうきゅうせい}に{会|あ}えた。
examples.english: I was able to meet classmates at the coming-of-age ceremony.

examples.japanese: {成人式|せいじんしき}は1{月|がつ}の{第|だい}2{月曜日|げつようび}に{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: The coming-of-age ceremony is held on the second Monday of January.

notes:
{成人式|せいじんしき} is a ceremony celebrating young people reaching adulthood. It is one of Japan's most visible cultural traditions.

DATE:
Held on {成人|せいじん}の{日|ひ} (Coming of Age Day), the second Monday of January.

ATTIRE:
- Women: {振袖|ふりそで} (long-sleeved kimono) — the most iconic image of the day
- Men: スーツ or {袴|はかま} (traditional hakama)

WHAT HAPPENS:
Local governments organize ceremonies with speeches. Afterwards, groups of friends often gather for reunions with former classmates.

AGE CHANGE:
In 2022, the legal age of adulthood was lowered from 20 to 18, but most municipalities still hold ceremonies for those turning 20, sometimes renamed {二十歳|はたち}のつどい.
